verdict.rationale: Quo's pricing page lists "Custom ring orders" and call transfers, and the homepage claims call routing to the right person on a shared team number, so ordered group ringing is documented at a feature-list level. Voicemail exists, since missed-call voicemail transcripts are referenced, but nothing documents configurable routing of unanswered calls. missing for 10: explicit simultaneous-ring option, documented fallback of unanswered calls to voicemail or another number, in-depth configuration docs for ring groups, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can ring a group in order or simultaneously, and route unanswered calls to voicemail or another number
